result.summary: The page appears mostly functional, but one notable visual issue was identified related to text truncation in a non-scrollable context.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section appears to be truncated mid-word (likely 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar), and since this is a label below a fixed-width card rather than a scrollable row edge item, the text is being clipped without any ellipsis indicator, making it look broken rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and white-space: nowrap to the restaurant name label so truncation is visually communicated clearly, or widen the card to accommodate longer names.
